items.Sentence: Grit is periodically removed from the lift station wet well.
The treatment system consists of a 300,000-gallon oxidation ditch, secondary clarifier, chlorine disinfection using calcium hypochlorite tablets, and dechlorination using sodium bisulfite.

The Facility discharges treated wastewater to three percolation ponds at Discharge Point 002. The percolation ponds are located in an upland area on property adjacent to the Facility across a deep ravine.
Solids removed from the secondary clarifier are dewatered in the Facility's sludge drying beds or an Aeromod Draimad bagger before being transported to an approved landfill for final disposal.

Solids were previously disposed of though land application in a wooded area owned by the Permittee north of the Facility; this practice was discontinued in 2018.
